limitations: Interim FORGE projections until native forecasts go live: each player's latest FORGE v2 daily line (runs 2026-10-20 to 2026-10-27) stands in for his remaining games; 32 of 32 teams covered.
Penalty minutes, plus-minus, shorthanded points, game-winning goals and faceoffs are season per-game rates (this season plus half of last, pulled toward league rates), not FORGE projections.

Future games move each FORGE line to that game's opponent with FORGE's team-strength adjustment (team xG for and against, 32 teams, last season blended in as 20 games), plus FORGE's home-ice and rest model (back-to-backs included); a goalie's start chance drops on the second night of a back-to-back, and each opponent's tilt toward forwards or defencemen (points and shots allowed by position vs league, shrunk).

Goalie wins: FORGE's per-game team win probability (both teams sum to 1) × 0.984 starter decision share, times his start chance; games FORGE has not projected yet use FORGE's same win model on team xG.

Goalie starts use each goalie's last-10 start share (season share when missing) from start rows for his current team this season: the row for that game when one exists, otherwise his latest. FORGE's own starter probability applies to an already projected game. Per-start lines come from his latest FORGE line, or his team's when he has none.
5 team-games have a goalie with no start share; the others keep their own shares, never scaled up, so start chances there sum to less than 1.
9 goalies have no current NHL team, so their start chances are unknown; the team their latest start row or FORGE line names keeps its other goalies' shares unscaled.
1 goalies have start shares only from another team or season; those are ignored, so their start chance is unknown.
Goalie news (IFTTT, accepted automatically): 0 confirmed, 0 likely or projected (start chance at least 80% / 65%), 0 ruled out.
70 skaters missing from their team's latest FORGE run get no forecast (likely scratched, injured or moved).
40 goalies with no start share get no forecast for games FORGE has not projected for them.
Only issued unconditional game forecasts are used. Conditional-only, missing, or out-of-horizon statistics are unknown, not zero.
servedLimitations: Interim FORGE projection: the player's latest FORGE game line, reused for this game.
